name: c4drill-gui
description: c4drill desktop GUI frontend (issue #31): CodeMirror editor, live diagram preview, AI chat

scripts.build: npm run grammar && tsc --noEmit && vite build
scripts.postbuild: touch dist/.gitkeep  # keeps go:embed working without a prior npm build
scripts.grammar: lezer-generator src/language/c4d.grammar -o src/language/c4d_parser.ts && node -e "const fs=require('fs');const p='src/language/c4d_parser.ts';const s=fs.readFileSync(p,'utf8');if(!s.startsWith('// @ts-nocheck'))fs.writeFileSync(p,'// @ts-nocheck\\n'+s)"
